title: Alesis Vortex Wireless 2 preset
description: A (possibly partial) preset. Omitted fields keep their value in the base preset.

description.description: Free text; ignored by the tool.

slot.description: Target slot 1..25. Optional; the command line can override it.

name.description: Preset name, up to 16 printable ASCII characters.

send_on_load.description: Send Program Change and Bank Select when this preset is loaded.

program_change.description: Program Change (+ Bank Select) message sent when the preset is loaded on the keytar.

curve.description: Velocity curve applied to the keybed.

enabled.description: true: keybed is divided at the split key; false: single zone.

key.description: Number of keys, counting from the lowest, that belong to the lower zone.

split.description: Splits the keybed into a lower and an upper zone.

midi_to_din.description: true: this zone's messages also go out of the DIN MIDI output; false: USB only.
true: this zone's messages also go out of the DIN MIDI output; false: USB only.

direction.description: Normal: turning right raises pitch; Reverse: it lowers it.

wheel.description: Bytes the vendor editor never shows. Preserved when reading from the keytar; omit unless you know why.

type.description: What the pad does. Determines which of the value keys below apply.

channel.description: MIDI channel the pad sends on.

color1.description: LED colour. Note pads: idle. Other types: idle/released.

color2.description: LED colour. Note pads: struck with velocity 1-63. Other types: on/pressed.

color3.description: LED colour (Note pads only): struck with velocity 64-95.

color4.description: LED colour (Note pads only): struck with velocity 96-127.

velocity.description: Note pads: fixed velocity; 0 means use the velocity curve.
